title: Prove two FULL calls cannot complete both rank-17 main targets (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped written proof and source-bound finite corroboration: two FULL native calls cannot complete the prospective `224 H17 + 2 H` main-only unit in either of two explicitly different columnwise Clifford models. No new supplier or kappa is claimed.

- With central/transverse address separation, a monomial-subgroup projection gives an invertible free matrix plus one outer product. Its nullity cannot accommodate two independent central Gaussian targets. Arbitrary external owner GL, noncommuting monomial-conjugate functions, width-dependent scalar choices and restored identity scratch are allowed.
- With exactly two main owners and no other states, the stronger lower-grade argument permits the full monomial Clifford subgroup, including central/fresh mixing. The untouched row/column of two triangular FULL maps forces a zero column in the arbitrary interstage matrix. This proof retains the actual rank-eight transverse factors and needs no commutation with a changed central query.

These scopes are not combined. Autonomous native helper outputs stay untouched. Existing transformed helper resources, extra owners in the full-routing model, inter-port mixing with unbound frames and non-columnwise address grammars remain outside the result.

The independent literal controlled-phase check makes both off-diagonal words rank 17 but leaves a nonzero rank 16 component, so a favorable maximal-grade count fails the complete endpoint gate. The proof uses a central-character twisted group algebra and separating tensor powers, preserving absolute phases and allowing scalar coefficients to depend on width; no width-one sum is silently tensorized.

## Task and overlap

This package retains arbitrary complex owner boundaries and different central functions. Nick Petalas [PR #4875](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4875), exact head `e1f0906c35defdc4704f2b3e5e954c2a62981791`, concerns the distinct same-phase rank-three dirty-shear endpoint. Their methods and scopes are credited in PROOF.md; neither is presented as proving this changed endpoint.

The source-native owned-zero-centre ABI is distinct from the retained 640 arbitrary-centre ABI. No independent centre reward or duplicate helper credit is introduced. Canonical main was freshly fetched before publication and remains the stated base. Latest submissions through [PR #4909](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4909) were checked;[PR #4908](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4908) cyclic recovery and [PR #4904](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4904) guarded two-target macros concern distinct endpoint/invoice questions. Bounded title/body/source overlap checks do not certify exhaustive novelty or unpublished ownership.

Final exact head: `7eb4ef5251f7ba96c7e5d78c42fc98e66b7be4ba`. [Hosted run 39874112461](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39874112461) passed at exact head `7eb4ef5251f7ba96c7e5d78c42fc98e66b7be4ba`:346 helper tests with 11 expected skips, both normal/optimized model checks, both portable grade replays and unchanged committed inputs. Registered outcome remains negative-result; CI success does not establish an endpoint or new kappa.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-full-central-obstruction
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-full-central-obstruction --check-source-history
```

Python 3.12/Linux, standard library only. Four registered normal/optimized commands pass: central model and portable independent grade replay. The central check constructs 96 exact Clifford elements/32 monomials,98,304 subgroup-support checks,64 two-letter expansion fixtures, full-rank modular Gram controls for 24 projective tensor words at widths 23..26, a complete three-query positive control and width-one sum/global-phase fault controls. These corroborate the written universal arguments; no circuit search was needed.

The portable grade adapter authenticates the unchanged independent author checker and exact retained Clifford engine, replaces only its Git source-loader with vendored bytes, regenerates in private scratch and compares the unchanged receipt. Both off-diagonal grades 17 and the failed lower-grade purity gate replay.

Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official 27-file export/integrity checks pass. Both optimized scientific commands pass from a Git-free export with PATH=/nonexistent and unchanged exported bytes. Six actual source/receipt/missing-file corruptions reject under normal and optimized Python without changing their inputs. A separate read-only final agent audit reports no remaining findings.

Independent accounting derives actual source `P={1:2201,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:8}` and `H={4:28,7:7,8:47,9:326}`. The hypothetical two-call moment is in `[39.063938114801903,39.063938114801904]` at C=.0030217758, but its endpoint is impossible in the stated models. Three FULL calls on the same two banks have margin `[-58.916072241014304,-58.916072241014303]`; the source sign-separated coefficient proof excludes all larger C through 1, and n>=4 unchanged two-bank invoices are negative for every C in[0,1].

The registered checker authenticates the frozen independent accounting/112-port wrapper receipts but does not regenerate that larger audit. Its local Git/support-script replay limitation is explicit in README and PROVENANCE. Source all-column/native632 and compiler/precision/tape/outer/Lean obligations were not rerun. RawD0 does not commute with the proposed S; all 112 exact translation corrections are retained in the independent audit, and the proof avoids assuming that commutation.

## Open next questions

A further free-word search cannot change this model's decision. Before a new construction experiment, name one actual changed resource: additional independent owners, an already-transformed helper state with a complete return contract, shared native-word fusion deleting paid jobs, or a changed target invoice. Derive its complete optimistic bill first. At the funded comparison, merely adding a third FULL call needs more than 58.916072241014304 in extra moment before any new work or reserve. No such resource is freely credited here.


## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated registered 27-file research package. No predecessor source, shared workflow, maintainer-selected record or runtime changes. The proof package supplies scoped negative endpoint results, not supplier admission.
